title: Making a new category the default moves the Default badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new Internal category for this test, category A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, whose default internal category is General Internal.
custom_steps:
1. Open Administration > Service > Internal Work Orders.
  2. Open the row menu of category A.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Tick "Default category".
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open customer A's page.
  7. Click Edit Customer on customer A's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The categories page opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows Edit.

Step 3:

  • The window opens.

Step 4:

  • The checkbox is ticked.

Step 5:

  • Category A shows the "Default" badge.
  • General Internal no longer shows it.

Step 6:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 7:

  • Customer A's "Default internal category" still shows General Internal: changing the default moved nothing on existing customers.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R14: “The category dialog ("New Internal Category", "New No Charge Category", or Edit with the current values) has: Name (required, unique within its list including archived categories, refused with "A category with this name is archived. Restore it instead."; 60 characters); "QuickBooks expense account", one picker per connected location listing that location's expense accounts (the same picker as the ShopView Accounts rows), with the helper "One per connected location, picked from the chart that is already in QuickBooks. Parts cost of this category posts here instead of Cost of Parts. Empty: posts to the ShopView Review account until you pick one."; on a No Charge category the checkbox "Requires the original work order" with the helper "The work order asks which earlier work order the job comes from, or Not in ShopView. Optional when the work order is created, required at Close."; on an Internal category the checkbox "Default category" with the helper "Used by internal customers that have no category of their own. One default at a time; it cannot be archived." Saving the account here and on the QuickBooks page (S5-R1) writes the same mapping; the account pickers are editable only with 'Settings — Integrations' and read-only with the text "Set in Integrations > QuickBooks" otherwise. The dialog shows the AccountingHub mapping as read-only text when the hub is enabled (the row is edited in the hub, S6-R1). A user without access to every connected location sees the pickers of the locations they can access; the other locations keep their mapping.”
  • S1-R16: “A category has a stable key; renaming it keeps the history, the report filter and the mappings. Archiving a category in use keeps it on existing work orders, lines, documents and reports; it is no longer offered in any select. The default Internal category cannot be archived; changing the default moves nothing on existing customers. The green QuickBooks mark (the existing QuickBooks icon) is shown wherever a field maps to QuickBooks: the account columns and pickers of S1-R13 and S1-R14, the asset field of S1-R15 and the Settings hint of S1-R3. Archiving a category that is the stored default of customers or assets first shows "[n] internal customers and [m] assets use this category as their default. Their new work orders will use the next category in line." The stored value stays on the customer and the asset, shown as "[name] (archived)" with the hint "Archived. Pick an active category."; resolution for a new work order (S2-R1) skips archived categories: the asset's, else the customer's, else the default Internal category, the first active one wins. Restore puts everything back as it was.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
